findings.title: Denial cache key omits identity type, so anonymous denials can deny renderer access
findings.body: The denial cache key is built from `checkReq.UserUID`, action, name, and parent folder only. `validateSubject` returns the same UID `"0"` for both `anonymous:0` and `render:0`. If an anonymous check for a dashboard is denied, `permDenialCache` stores a key such as `org-12.perm_0_dashboards:read_dash1_fold1`. A later renderer check for the same dashboard and folder hits this denial entry at line 117 and returns `Allowed: false` before `getRendererPermissions` can grant the renderer wildcard read access. This causes authorized rendering to fail depending on prior anonymous requests.

findings.title: List treats a cached empty or stale permission map as authoritative and skips DB refresh
findings.body: `List` only falls back to `getIdentityPermissions` when `getCachedIdentityPermissions` returns an error. A cached empty map (`map[string]bool{}`) is a successful cache hit, so `List` passes it directly to `listPermission`. A user who listed dashboards before creating any (or before the new permission was granted) can have an empty/partial `permCache` entry; after creating a dashboard, the next list request will keep returning the stale cached map until the 30s TTL expires. The client-side `NoopCache` change does not help because this is the server-side `permCache`. This undermines the PR goal of letting creators fetch newly created dashboards/folders.

findings.title: Permission denial cache key can collide when name/parent contain underscores
findings.body: `userPermDenialCacheKey` concatenates namespace, UID, action, name, and parent with underscores and no escaping or length delimiter. Dashboard names and folder UIDs can contain underscores, so distinct tuples can produce the same key. For example, `name="a_b", parent="c"` and `name="a", parent="b_c"` both produce a suffix like `dashboards:read_a_b_c`. A cached denial for one resource can therefore be served for a different resource, causing an authorized check to be denied.
